Klaus Mueller

The episodes usually last about three or four minutes, where I just stare and my face makes strange faces, but I don't remember anything happening. My brother says I make hand gestures and wake up looking confused and very tired afterward. There is no shaking or falling down, just this weird muddy taste in my mouth right before it starts.
